topic: Practical on aircraft wiring routing and repair like crimping, insulating using heat sleeve, Solder sleeve etc.
syllabus_extract: Practical on aircraft wiring routing and repair like crimping, insulating using heat sleeve, Solder sleeve etc.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Hands-on practice on crimping terminals, applying heat shrink sleeves, and using solder sleeves on aircraft wiring samples.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of aircraft wiring degradation?
Why is proper crimping essential for electrical continuity?
What safety precautions must be observed during soldering operations?

topics: Preparation of wire ends and stripping techniques
Selection and application of crimping tools
Inspection of crimp quality and terminal fit
Application of heat shrink insulation sleeves
Use of solder sleeves for additional protection
development.content:
Preparation of wire ends and stripping techniques
Selection and application of crimping tools
Inspection of crimp quality and terminal fit
Application of heat shrink insulation sleeves
Use of solder sleeves for additional protection

topics: Securing wires with clips and ties
Labeling and identification of repaired wires
development.content:
Routing wires through aircraft structure
Securing wires with clips and ties
Avoiding interference with moving parts
Maintaining proper bend radius
Labeling and identification of repaired wires

topics: Review of common defects and corrections
development.content:
Final inspection of repaired wiring
Testing continuity and insulation resistance
Documentation of repair details
Cleaning work area and tools
Review of common defects and corrections

summary_questions: Describe the correct procedure for applying a heat shrink sleeve to ensure a proper seal.
Identify three signs of a defective crimp and explain how to correct each.
Explain why solder sleeves are used in addition to heat shrink insulation in certain applications.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report detailing the steps for routing a wire bundle in a confined space, referencing the procedures to be covered in LP 22 regarding connector pin insertion.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on aircraft connectors like pin configuration, insertion and exertion of connector pins, insulation check.
